text: Gold edged up about 0.3% overnight to roughly $4,005, back just above $4,000 after last week's steep drop.
Silver rose about 0.8% to near $54.30, nudging the gold/silver ratio down to about 73.8.
Brent fell about 1% to near $115 on hopes of easing US–Iran tensions, though attacks on Saudi supply kept it well above $100.
Treasury yields were little changed ahead of the Fed: the 10-year near 4.98% and the 2-year near 4.68%.
Stock futures rose before the open, with Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.6% and S&P 500 futures up about 0.4%, as tech steadied and oil eased.
The yen held near a one-month high with USD/JPY around 157, and the dollar index slipped to about 101.6.
Bitcoin hovered near $80,000, slightly below Friday evening, as traders cut risk before the Fed.
